userStories.title: Slide JP direct split-gripper same-env config
userStories.description: Create experiments/slide_block_to_target_sameenv_dino_depth_diffusion_lora8_jpdirect_splitgripper.yaml for slide_block_to_target by copying the existing slide JP-direct diffusion config and adding the split-gripper diffusion settings used by the close_box split-gripper configs. Required settings: dataset.task=slide_block_to_target, action_pipeline_preset=joint_position_direct, action_output_activation=identity, policy_head_type=diffusion, separate_gripper_head=true, gripper_head_hidden_dim=128, gripper_loss_weight=4.0, and the JP joint position bounds [-2.8973,-1.7628,-2.8973,-3.0718,-2.8973,-0.0175,-2.8973,0.0] / [2.8973,1.7628,2.8973,-0.0698,2.8973,3.7525,2.8973,1.0].
acceptanceCriteria: The config sets dataset.task to slide_block_to_target

userStories.title: Slide JP-servo split-gripper same-env config
userStories.description: Create experiments/slide_block_to_target_sameenv_dino_depth_diffusion_lora8_jpservo_splitgripper.yaml for slide_block_to_target by copying the slide JP-servo diffusion config and adding the split-gripper settings from the close_box JP-servo split-gripper config. Required servo settings: joint_velocity_servo_gain=20.0, joint_velocity_servo_clip=1.0, joint_velocity_servo_steps=2, joint_velocity_servo_tolerance=0.01. Keep policy_head_type=diffusion, action_output_activation=identity, and set separate_gripper_head=true, gripper_head_hidden_dim=128, gripper_loss_weight=4.0.
acceptanceCriteria: The config sets dataset.task to slide_block_to_target

userStories.title: Slide JP-servo split-gripper gain-clip variants
userStories.description: Create two slide split-gripper JP-servo variants for gain/clip sweep: experiments/slide_block_to_target_sameenv_dino_depth_diffusion_lora8_jpservo_g30c10_splitgripper.yaml and experiments/slide_block_to_target_sameenv_dino_depth_diffusion_lora8_jpservo_g20c05_splitgripper.yaml. Both should be copies of the slide split-gripper JP-servo config, with dataset.task=slide_block_to_target and the same split-gripper settings, but the first must use gain=30.0 clip=1.0 and the second must use gain=20.0 clip=0.5. Both keep servo steps=2 and tolerance=0.01.
acceptanceCriteria: The g30c10 config uses joint_velocity_servo_gain: 30.0 and joint_velocity_servo_clip: 1.0
The g20c05 config uses joint_velocity_servo_gain: 20.0 and joint_velocity_servo_clip: 0.5

userStories.title: Slide chunk4exec2 split-gripper JP configs
userStories.description: Create two chunked split-gripper slide configs: experiments/slide_block_to_target_sameenv_dino_depth_diffusion_lora8_jpdirect_chunk4exec2_splitgripper.yaml and experiments/slide_block_to_target_sameenv_dino_depth_diffusion_lora8_jpservo_chunk4exec2_splitgripper.yaml. Use the slide JP-direct and JP-servo split-gripper one-step configs as templates, then set dataset.action_chunk_len=4 and dataset.receding_horizon_execute_steps=2. Keep the same split-gripper settings and JP bounds/servo settings from the corresponding one-step config.

userStories.title: Start Ralph tmux wrapper
userStories.description: Create scripts/start_ralph_tmux.sh as a small wrapper to launch Ralph in a detached tmux session. The script should accept an optional session name argument defaulting to ralph_loop, create logs/ralph if needed, build a timestamped log path under logs/ralph, export RALPH_CODEX_COMMAND='/home/cvlab-dgx/.local/bin/codex exec', start tmux detached in the repo root running 'python3 ralph.py 2>&1 | tee <log>', and print the session name plus log path at the end. Make the script executable.
acceptanceCriteria: The script exports RALPH_CODEX_COMMAND pointing at /home/cvlab-dgx/.local/bin/codex exec
